The N-pole of a magnet is moved into a coil of wire connected to a galvanometer.
coil

The needle of the galvanometer moves.
Which situation must give a smaller galvanometer reading?
A
Use a coil with fewer turns and a stronger magnet.
B
Use a coil with fewer turns and a weaker magnet.
C
Use a coil with more turns and a stronger magnet.
D
Use a coil with more turns and a weaker magnet.
